_meta.description: Curated golden Q&A set for E2E RAG regression testing. Each item targets a document that is physically present in test_analysis_agent/knowledge_base as of this audit (2026-08-30). expected_answer is an intentionally high-level, publicly-known summary of the standard's scope -- it is meant as a soft reference for deepeval's GEval judge (semantic comparison against the model's actual output + retrieved context), NOT a verbatim string match. Regenerate/expand this file with generate_golden_dataset.py once a subject-matter expert can validate clause-level expected answers against the actual PDF text.
_meta.excluded_reason: Listed in vector_embed.DOCS / DOC_METADATA_LOOKUP but not present under knowledge_base/ at audit time -- see rag_e2e.feature scenario 'DOCS registry stays in sync with files on disk'.

golden_set.question: What is the general scope and purpose of MIL-STD-461?
golden_set.expected_answer: MIL-STD-461 establishes electromagnetic interference (EMI) requirements and test methods for the control of electromagnetic emissions and susceptibility characteristics of electronic, electrical, and electromechanical equipment.

golden_set.question: What kind of equipment does MIL-STD-1586A apply to and what does it cover?
golden_set.expected_answer: MIL-STD-1586A covers airborne electronic equipment configuration/qualification guidance, addressing environmental and physical requirements applicable to airborne hardware.

golden_set.question: What system life cycle processes are defined in ISO/IEC/IEEE 15288?
golden_set.expected_answer: ISO/IEC/IEEE 15288 defines a common framework of system life cycle processes covering agreement, organizational project-enabling, technical management, and technical processes used to describe the life cycle of human-made systems.

golden_set.question: What is the purpose of ISO/IEC/IEEE 29119-1 and what does it define?
golden_set.expected_answer: ISO/IEC/IEEE 29119-1 defines vocabulary, concepts, and a general framework for software testing that underpins the rest of the 29119 series (test processes, documentation, and techniques).

golden_set.question: What test documentation artifacts does the IEEE 829 test documentation standard require?
golden_set.expected_answer: IEEE 829-2008 specifies the format and content of a set of software test documents, including test plans, test design specifications, test case specifications, test procedures, and test summary reports.

golden_set.question: What does MIL-STD-882E require with respect to hazard risk assessment?
golden_set.expected_answer: MIL-STD-882E establishes the DoD system safety process, requiring identification of hazards, assessment of their risk (severity x probability), and mitigation to an acceptable level before fielding a system.

golden_set.question: What security control families does NIST SP 800-53 define, and how does access control fit in?
golden_set.expected_answer: NIST SP 800-53 defines a catalog of security and privacy controls organized into families (e.g. Access Control, Audit and Accountability, System and Communications Protection) that federal information systems select and implement based on risk.

golden_set.question: According to the internal requirements_and_testing notes, what makes a requirement testable?
golden_set.expected_answer: A requirement is testable when it specifies objective, measurable criteria -- e.g. explicit thresholds/limits, timing/duration, error messaging, and expected system state -- so that a test case can produce a pass/fail verdict without interpretation.

out_of_domain_set.question: What is the best recipe for lasagna?
out_of_domain_set.expectation: The agent should either decline (off-topic for a systems/testing standards assistant) or, if it calls search_testing_standards, explicitly state that the retrieved sections don't cover this rather than answering from general knowledge.

out_of_domain_set.question: What does DO-178C say about software levels?
out_of_domain_set.expectation: DO-178C is not in the knowledge base. The agent must not answer from parametric memory -- it should state the retrieved sections don't cover this standard.
